text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I don't have a shell tool in this session, so I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my choice, since the tests only check the title and the count.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
